name: Pressing triggers 6v4+GK
objective: Recognise pressing triggers (back-pass, poor touch, ball to full-back) and press as a unit.
setup: Reds (4 + GK) build out to two end gates; Blues (6) press. Blues score by winning the ball and finishing within 8 seconds.
coaching_points: Nearest player presses on the trigger, curved run to cut the passing lane
Second player screens the obvious pass
Rest of the unit shifts across together, no gaps between lines
progression: Reds score a point for 5 consecutive passes; reduce Blues to 5.

name: 5-second counter-press rondo
objective: React immediately on losing the ball: win it back inside 5 seconds or recover shape.
setup: 6v6 possession game. Team that loses the ball gets a bonus point if they regain it within 5 seconds.
coaching_points: First reaction is forward, not back
Swarm the ball side, cut the outlet pass
If not won in 5 s, drop into shape
progression: Add two target players on the end lines for the team in possession.

name: Compact mid-block shadow play
objective: Move as two compact lines; keep 10-15 m between units and protect the centre.
setup: Coach moves the ball around a ring of mannequins/players; team shifts as a block on each pass.
coaching_points: Distance between lines no more than 15 m
Ball-side full-back steps, far side tucks in
Strikers screen the pivot, show play wide
progression: Add 4 live attackers who try to play through the lines.

name: Defend the box 6v6
objective: Protect the box: body shape, blocking shots, defending crosses.
setup: Attackers recycle from wide feeders; defenders score by clearing to a target beyond the halfway mannequin.
coaching_points: Stay goal-side, see ball and man
Block line of shot with the body, not the hands
Attack the ball on crosses — first contact
progression: Add a 60-second 'protect the lead' period where defenders must hold a 1-0.

name: Play through the lines 4v4+3
objective: Break lines with forward passes and third-man runs; play forward early.
setup: Three zones. Team in possession must play from end zone through middle (neutral) to the far end player within 4 passes.
coaching_points: Look forward first: can I break a line?
Receive on the half-turn
Third-man run beyond the receiver
progression: Limit to 2 touches; add a defender in the middle zone.

name: Counter-attack waves 3v2
objective: Attack quickly after a turnover: run in behind, commit defenders, finish within 10 s.
setup: Coach serves to 3 attackers on halfway; 2 defenders recover. Continuous waves.
coaching_points: Ball carrier attacks space at speed
Wide runners stretch the defenders
Final pass before the defender recovers
progression: Add a recovering third defender after 3 s.

name: Build-up under pressure 5v3+GK
objective: Play out from the back calmly against a press using width and the pivot.
setup: GK + 4 defenders + pivot vs 3 pressers. Score by passing through a gate on halfway.
coaching_points: Centre-backs split wide, GK is the spare man
Pivot shows between the pressers
If pressed, go long early to the channel — not across the box
progression: Add a 4th presser; allow the long ball only into a target zone.

name: Rondo 5v2 two-touch
objective: Ball security under pressure: body shape, angles, quick decisions.
setup: Five on the outside, two in the middle. Defender who wins it swaps with the player who lost it.
coaching_points: Open body to see the next pass
Pass to the far foot
Split pass between the two defenders scores a bonus
progression: One touch; make the square smaller.

name: Wide overloads 2v1 + cross
objective: Create 2v1s out wide with overlaps/underlaps and deliver early crosses.
setup: Winger + full-back vs one defender in a channel; 2 strikers vs 2 centre-backs in the box.
coaching_points: Timing of the overlap: go when the winger draws the defender
Cross early to the near post or cut back
Strikers: one near, one far, cross over
progression: Add a recovering defender to make it 2v2.

name: Switch of play 6v6 with wide zones
objective: Draw the opponent to one side, then switch quickly to the free wide player.
setup: Two wide channels with a floater each. Goal counts double if the ball went through both channels in the move.
coaching_points: Overload one side to attract pressure
Switch in two passes max (via pivot)
Far-side player stays wide — don't drift in early
progression: Floaters limited to 2 touches.

name: Central combinations 3v2 to goal
objective: Combine in tight central spaces: wall passes, third-man runs, shots from the edge.
setup: Three attackers (10 + two strikers) vs two centre-backs, play starts from a midfielder's pass.
coaching_points: Lay-off and spin
10 arrives late into the box
Shoot early when the lane opens
progression: Add a holding midfielder for the defence (3v3).

name: Back-three shifting & cover
objective: Three centre-backs and wing-backs shift together; cover behind the stepping defender.
setup: Attackers play into a striker or wide; back five must stay connected and win the ball.
coaching_points: Outside CB steps to the wide forward, middle CB covers
Wing-back drops when ball is far side → back five
Communicate the step and the cover
progression: Add a 5th attacker running beyond.

name: Wing-back timing & delivery
objective: Wing-backs time forward runs and recovery runs; deliver from wide.
setup: Ball worked from CB to CM to wing-back on the run; cross to two strikers. On a shout, wing-back sprints back to a cone.
coaching_points: Start the run as the CM receives
Look up before the cross
Recovery run immediately after delivery
progression: Add a defending winger who tracks the run.

name: Front-three pressing angles
objective: Front three press with curved runs to show play one way and trap it.
setup: Back four + GK try to play out; front three try to win it inside the zone.
coaching_points: Striker curves to cut the CB-to-CB pass
Wingers jump on the full-back on the pass, not before
Trap on the touchline
progression: Add a pivot for the builders; front three get a midfielder to help.

name: Midfield triangle rotations
objective: Rotate within the 6-8-8 triangle to create passing angles and free the pivot.
setup: CBs to midfield triangle to striker targets; 3 defenders try to block.
coaching_points: Never in a straight line — keep triangles
When an 8 drops, the other pushes on
Pivot scans before receiving
progression: Two-touch limit; add a 4th defender.

name: Double pivot: screen and progress
objective: Two holding midfielders: one supports the ball, one screens behind it.
setup: Possession in middle third; on turnover, opponents counter at two mini-goals the pivots protect.
coaching_points: One shows, one holds
Never both pivots on the same line as the ball
On turnover, the holder delays the counter
progression: Remove one centre-back so the pivot must cover.

name: Finding the 10 in the pocket
objective: Find the attacking midfielder between opposition midfield and defence.
setup: Team scores by receiving in the 'pocket' zone and turning to play to a striker.
coaching_points: 10 moves off the defender's shoulder
Receive on the back foot to turn
Striker pins the CBs
progression: Pocket zone player has 2 touches.

name: Strike partnership: near & far
objective: Two strikers coordinate: one checks short, one runs in behind.
setup: Midfielder plays into either striker; they combine against two defenders to finish.
coaching_points: Opposite movements — one short, one long
Flick-ons and knock-downs
Attack the second ball
progression: Add a third defender (back three) to solve.

name: Rest defence 7v5 + counter goals
objective: While attacking, keep a secure structure behind the ball to stop counters.
setup: Attacking team (7) must keep 3 players behind the ball line; if defenders win it they counter at 2 mini-goals.
coaching_points: 2+1 or 3+2 rest-defence behind the ball
Mark the opposition's best outlet
Delay, don't dive in, on turnover
progression: Counter-attackers score double within 6 s.

name: Protect the lead: game scenarios
objective: Rehearse the last 15 minutes: protecting a lead, killing time legally, staying organised when tired.
setup: 11v11 with a scenario: '1-0 up, 12 minutes left'. Subs are made as in the match plan.
coaching_points: Keep the ball in the opponent's half
Clear lines — no risky passes
Subs know their role before stepping on
progression: Play the opposite scenario: '0-1 down, need a goal'.

name: Repeat-sprint pressing conditioning
objective: Build the capacity to repeat pressing sprints late in games.
setup: 6 x (5 s sprint press to a cone + 20 s jog recovery), 3 sets with 2 min rest.
coaching_points: Max intensity on the press
Active recovery between
Monitor RPE — scale for youth players
progression: Add a ball: the sprint finishes with a tackle on a server.

name: Attacking corner routines
objective: Two rehearsed corner routines: near-post flick and edge-of-box cut-back.
setup: Walk through, then live against 5 defenders and a GK.
coaching_points: Clear signals for each routine
Blockers free the target runner
Second-ball player on the edge of the box
progression: Defenders know one routine is coming but not which.

name: Defending set pieces: zonal + man
objective: A hybrid set-piece defence: zonal line on the 6-yard box plus markers on the best headers.
setup: Coach serves 10 corners and 5 wide free kicks; attackers score by any contact into the goal.
coaching_points: Zonal players attack the ball, don't wait
Markers: body contact, eyes on the ball
Everyone out together after the clearance
progression: Add a short-corner option to test reorganisation.

name: 1v1 defending in wide areas
objective: Full-backs and wide players learn to stop a winger: body shape, show them one way, delay until help arrives.
setup: Winger receives at the top of a wide channel and tries to dribble over an end line or cross into a mini-goal; defender starts 8 m away. Rotate every 3 reps.
coaching_points: Close down fast, then slow down the last 2 m — arrive balanced
Side-on, show them onto their weaker foot or the touchline
Don't dive in: delay until the covering midfielder arrives
progression: Add a covering midfielder who joins after 3 seconds to make it 2v1 for the defence.

name: Finishing from crosses & cut-backs
objective: Strikers and midfielders attack the box with the right runs and finish first time from crosses and cut-backs.
setup: Wide player receives, beats a cone and crosses or cuts back. Three runners attack near post, far post and penalty spot. Alternate sides.
coaching_points: Arrive late and fast — don't stand waiting in the box
Near post, far post, penalty spot: never two in the same space
Hit the target first time: low and hard or across the keeper
progression: Add two defenders and a time limit of 8 seconds from the wide pass.
